# Lab 16.8: Data Engineering Agent: Change & Troubleshoot

## What We Are Going to Do
Ask the agent to change an existing pipeline, fix a failing step, and add data quality checks.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Change the pipeline.** Ask: *"Add a column with the number of distinct customers per category per day."* Review the diff and accept.

2. **[Console] Break something.** Edit the staging view so it reads a column that doesn't exist (for example `sale_prize`). Run the pipeline. It fails.

3. **[Console] Ask the agent to fix it.** *"The last run failed. Find the problem and fix it."* The agent reads the error, finds the typo and proposes the fix.

4. **[Console] Add quality checks.** *"Add assertions: order_id is unique in staging, category is never null, and the daily table has data for yesterday."*

5. **[Console] Commit.** Run the pipeline again, then commit the changes with a clear message.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Changes | Shown as diffs |
| Troubleshooting | Agent reads the error and fixes it |
| Quality | New assertions added |
| Version control | Normal Dataform commits |
